missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Личность' is the nominative predicate noun. 'Яркая' agrees in the feminine, and 'очень' intensifies the description even though the subject is a man.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Личность' is the accusative object of 'уважаю'; this soft-sign feminine noun keeps the same form in the accusative. 'Сильную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О творческой личности' uses the prepositional form 'личности' after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Творческой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Личности' is genitive, expressing whose merits are described. 'Достоинств' is genitive plural after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Личности' is the dative governed by 'помогает', marking who is helped. 'Каждой' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'восхищаться'. 'Личностью' is the instrumental required by the verb 'восхищаются'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Личности' is genitive following 'без' to express absence. 'Сильной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Личность' is the nominative subject of 'вызывает'. 'Эта' agrees in the feminine, and 'уважение' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Личности' is the nominative plural subject. 'Великие' agrees in the plural, and 'в истории' marks the prepositional setting.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Об известных личностях' uses the prepositional plural after 'об' to mark the topic. 'Известных' agrees in the plural.
